q: A catalyst maker asks our Rustenburg platinum smelter for carbon data. Is it a CBAM good?
title: Rustenburg PGM smelter buyer carbon data
short: No. Platinum group metals are not CBAM goods. The buyer wants a Scope 3 figure: emissions from mining, concentrating, smelting and refining per ounce or kilogram, where Eskom electricity is usually the largest part. Give the allocation basis between metals.
audience: Platinum group metal miners, smelters and refiners in the Rustenburg area

ul: Electricity for furnaces and concentrators, at the Eskom grid factor.

p: One ore yields platinum, palladium, rhodium and base metals. Say whether emissions are split by mass or by value; value allocation puts most of it on the precious metals.
Car catalyst makers usually want kilograms of CO2e per kilogram of metal, with the year and the grid factor used.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
